faqs.q: What is the 3-point hitch lay flat hose mover used for?
faqs.a: The lay flat hose mover is a tractor attachment for picking up and moving lay flat hose lines that are too heavy to drag by hand. It relocates irrigation and slurry supply lines between fields or clears a dewatering line off a work area.

faqs.q: How does the 3-point hitch lay flat hose mover guide the hose?
faqs.a: It mounts on the tractor 3-point hitch and guides the hose on a wheel, so the hose is not pulled over rough ground. That reduces manual dragging and hose damage when lines are deployed and retrieved.

faqs.q: What hose does the 3-point hitch hose mover handle?
faqs.a: It is made for TPU and NBR lay flat hose, in the long, heavy lines used for irrigation, slurry transfer and site water. Tell us the hose bore and the length to be handled when you enquire.

faqs.q: What power does the lay flat hose mover need?
faqs.a: The power source is the tractor, with the unit carried on the 3-point hitch. Confirm the tractor and the hitch category with us before ordering; the specification is confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: What hose does the hose mover work with, and what couplings?
faqs.a: It works with TPU and NBR lay flat hose of the bore you give us. For the couplings that join the lines see our [lay flat hose couplings](/c/lay-flat-hose-couplings).

faqs.q: Is the lay flat hose mover built to a standard?
faqs.a: No standard or certificate is listed for the mover. It is a built-to-order tractor attachment, so state any site safety requirement with the enquiry.

faqs.q: How should lay flat hose be rolled and stored after the mover retrieves it?
faqs.a: Drain the hose, roll it flat from the far end and store the coil out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects. See our [how to roll and store lay flat hose guide](/blog/how-to-roll-and-store-lay-flat-hose) for the method.

faqs.q: Where is the lay flat hose mover used?
faqs.a: It is used in large-scale irrigation, slurry and fluid transfer lines, and industrial and site water lines that move often. The [slurry umbilical system guide](/blog/slurry-umbilical-system-guide) shows the use.

faqs.q: Hose mover or tractor-mounted hose reel?
faqs.a: The mover guides and relocates hose on a wheel, while the [tractor-mounted hydraulic hose reel](/p/tractor-mounted-lay-flat-hose-reel) winds the hose onto a drum driven by tractor hydraulics. Choose the reel for laying and recovering a full run.

faqs.q: What do I send to quote a lay flat hose mover?
faqs.a: Send the hose bore and length to be handled, how the unit will be moved (towed, tractor-mounted, truck or by hand) and the power available on site. Specification, price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: Do you supply the lay flat hose mover from Dubai?
faqs.a: The mover is built to order, so we confirm lead time with the quotation. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide with the best lead times; send details through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Can the hose mover handle other hose types?
faqs.a: It is intended for TPU and NBR lay flat hose. For other hoses, tell us the type and bore and we confirm whether the unit suits it.

faqs.q: What is the portable motorised lay flat hose winder used for?
faqs.a: The portable motorised winder winds large-bore lay flat hose back onto a drum after use, a job that takes several people by hand at 6" and above. It is pushed to the hose end, the hose is fed onto the motorised drum, and the coil is wheeled away.

faqs.q: What hose sizes and lengths does the portable hose winder take?
faqs.a: It takes DN150 to DN300 (6" to 12") lay flat hose, in coils of up to 40 m. For longer runs the tractor reel or trailer systems on the [lay flat hose reels and winders](/c/lay-flat-hose-reels-winders) shelf are the alternatives.

faqs.q: How is the portable lay flat hose winder driven and moved?
faqs.a: It has motorised winding and is wheeled and portable, so it moves with the hose crew. It is intended for short-distance hose laying and recovery rather than long-distance runs.

faqs.q: What hose types can the portable winder handle?
faqs.a: The portable winder handles TPU, NBR and PVC lay flat hose. Tell us the hose bore, length and the fluid so we confirm the winder suits it before you order.

faqs.q: What power does the portable hose winder need?
faqs.a: The drive is motorised, and the power available on site should be stated with the enquiry. The specification, price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation, and units are built to order.

faqs.q: Does the portable lay flat hose winder have a certificate?
faqs.a: No standard or certificate is listed for the portable winder; it is built to order. State any site safety requirement on the enquiry and we confirm it with the quotation.

faqs.q: How do I wind lay flat hose properly after use?
faqs.a: Drain the hose, then feed it onto the winder drum from the far end so the water is pushed out as it rolls flat. See our [how to roll and store lay flat hose guide](/blog/how-to-roll-and-store-lay-flat-hose) for the method.

faqs.q: Where is the portable lay flat hose winder used?
faqs.a: It is used in industrial and municipal pumping and bypass work, agricultural irrigation and slurry lines, and emergency flood pumping and fire water supply. See the [flood response pumping guide](/blog/flood-response-pumping-lay-flat-hose).

faqs.q: Portable winder or tractor-mounted hose reel?
faqs.a: The portable winder is wheeled and handles 6" to 12" hose in coils up to 40 m, while the [tractor-mounted reel](/p/tractor-mounted-lay-flat-hose-reel) is driven by tractor hydraulics for much longer runs.

faqs.q: What do I send to quote a portable lay flat hose winder?
faqs.a: Send the hose bore and length to be handled, how the unit will be moved (towed, tractor-mounted, truck or by hand) and the power available on site. Units are built to order.

faqs.q: Do you supply the portable hose winder from Dubai?
faqs.a: Units are built to order, so lead time is confirmed with the quotation. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide with the best lead times; send details through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Can the portable winder handle flood-response hose lines?
faqs.a: Yes, emergency flood pumping and fire water supply are listed uses, within the 6" to 12" size range. See the [lay flat hose size chart](/blog/lay-flat-hose-size-chart).

faqs.q: What is the large-bore 8-inch riser hose winding system used for?
faqs.a: It is a trailer-mounted powered reel for high-yield water supply wells and dewatering bores fitted with 8" lay flat riser hose. A swing arm guides the hose over the well head while the reel lowers and recovers the pump and riser in one continuous length.

faqs.q: What capacity does the 8-inch riser hose winding system have?
faqs.a: It holds 150 m of 8" lay flat riser hose. Power, dimensions and weight are confirmed with the quotation, since each unit is built to order.

faqs.q: How is the 8-inch riser winding system driven?
faqs.a: It has a powered reel on a road trailer, with a swing-arm hose guide over the well head. The power source and the electrical or engine requirement are confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: What hose does the 8-inch riser hose winder fit?
faqs.a: It is for TPU lay flat well riser hose, 8", and the heavy-duty TPU riser hose. Pair it with the [stainless riser couplings](/p/stainless-well-riser-hose-coupling).

faqs.q: What connects to the 8-inch riser hose winding trailer?
faqs.a: The riser hose runs from the submersible pump to the well head, joined with stainless riser couplings at the pump outlet and discharge. See the [well riser hose installation guide](/blog/well-riser-hose-installation).

faqs.q: Does the 8-inch riser winding system carry a certificate?
faqs.a: No standard or certificate is listed for the 8-inch winding system. It is built to order, so state your site requirements on the enquiry and we confirm them with the quotation.

faqs.q: How do you lower a pump on riser hose with this system?
faqs.a: The powered reel controls the descent of the pump and riser and recovers them in one continuous length, so no crane or pipe-handling rig is needed. See the [flexible borehole riser guide](/blog/flexible-borehole-riser-vs-steel-column-pipe).

faqs.q: Where is the 8-inch riser hose winding system used?
faqs.a: The 8-inch winding system is used on municipal and agricultural high-yield water wells and on mine and construction dewatering bores, with heavy-duty TPU lay flat riser hose.

faqs.q: 8-inch riser winder or 2-inch well riser winding trailer?
faqs.a: The 8" system handles 150 m of large-bore riser for high-yield wells, while the [2-inch trailer](/p/well-riser-hose-winding-trailer-2-inch) handles 300 m of 2" riser hose with cable and has its own generator.

faqs.q: What do I send to quote the 8-inch riser hose winding system?
faqs.a: Send the hose bore and length to be handled, how the unit will be moved (towed, tractor-mounted, truck or by hand) and the power available on site.

faqs.q: Do you supply the 8-inch riser winding system from Dubai?
faqs.a: The 8-inch winding system is built to order, so lead time is confirmed with the quotation. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide with the best lead times; send details through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Can the 8-inch riser winder wind other hose sizes?
faqs.a: It is specified for 8" riser hose, 150 m per reel. For other bores, give us the hose size and the borehole depth on the enquiry and we confirm what suits.

faqs.q: What is the tractor-mounted lay flat hose reel used for?
faqs.a: The tractor-mounted reel lays out and winds in long runs of large-bore lay flat hose, such as the supply lines of slurry umbilical systems and temporary irrigation mains. A high-torque hydraulic motor drives it from the tractor hydraulics, so one operator can deploy or recover a full reel.

faqs.q: How much hose does the tractor-mounted reel hold?
faqs.a: It holds 2,000 ft (about 610 m) of 6" lay flat hose, a run of 3 to 10 hose lengths. Tell us the hose bore and length so we confirm it fits.

faqs.q: What drives the tractor hose reel?
faqs.a: A heavy-duty, high-torque hydraulic motor, powered from the tractor hydraulics. The power source is the tractor, so no separate engine is needed.

faqs.q: How is the tractor hose reel mounted?
faqs.a: The tractor reel mounts on the 3-point hitch, at the front or rear of the tractor. Confirm your tractor and hitch with us before ordering, since the specification is confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: What hose does the tractor reel work with?
faqs.a: The tractor reel is made for TPU lay flat slurry supply hose, in the bore you give us, and takes 3 to 10 hose lengths. See our [slurry umbilical system guide](/blog/slurry-umbilical-system-guide).

faqs.q: Does the tractor reel carry a certificate?
faqs.a: No standard or certificate is listed for the tractor reel. It is built to order, so state any site or safety requirement with the enquiry and we confirm it with the quotation.

faqs.q: How should lay flat hose be stored on the reel?
faqs.a: Drain the hose and wind it flat from the far end onto the reel, and keep coils out of direct sunlight. See the [how to roll and store lay flat hose guide](/blog/how-to-roll-and-store-lay-flat-hose) for the method.

faqs.q: Where is the tractor-mounted hose reel used?
faqs.a: It is used in slurry and manure umbilical systems, temporary irrigation and transfer mains, and dewatering lines that move often.

faqs.q: Tractor reel or hose mover?
faqs.a: The reel winds the hose onto a drum with tractor hydraulics, while the [3-point hitch hose mover](/p/lay-flat-hose-mover) guides and relocates a laid line on a wheel. Pick the reel to deploy and recover a full run.

faqs.q: What do I send to quote a tractor-mounted lay flat hose reel?
faqs.a: Send the hose bore and length to be handled, how the unit will be moved (towed, tractor-mounted, truck or by hand) and the power available on site.

faqs.q: Do you supply the tractor hose reel from Dubai?
faqs.a: It is built to order, so lead time is confirmed with the quotation. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide with the best lead times; send details through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Can the tractor reel hold other hose sizes?
faqs.a: It is specified for 6" hose at 2,000 ft. For other bores the capacity changes, so give us the bore and length and we confirm.

faqs.q: What is the well riser hose winding trailer used for?
faqs.a: It is a self-contained trailer for running lay flat riser hose and the pump cable down a borehole and winding it back out for pump service. The powered reel controls the descent of the pump and hose without a crane or pipe-handling rig.

faqs.q: What capacity does the 2-inch well riser winding trailer have?
faqs.a: It holds 300 m of 2" riser hose with cable. The reel has a 400 mm core, 1,300 mm outer diameter and is 605 mm wide, and carries up to 1,400 kg.

faqs.q: What power does the well riser winding trailer need?
faqs.a: The winding motor is 5.5 kW, 380 V three-phase, and an on-board 8 kW diesel generator, 380 V, means the trailer works at remote wells with no mains supply.

faqs.q: How big and heavy is the 2-inch riser hose winding trailer?
faqs.a: The trailer is a heavy unit: overall size is 4,300 × 2,370 × 2,500 mm and weight is 3,500 kg. Check site road access, tow capacity and unloading arrangements before ordering the winding trailer, since this is a large unit.

faqs.q: What hose and couplings does the riser winding trailer use?
faqs.a: The winding trailer is for TPU lay flat well riser hose with the pump cable, fitted with stainless riser couplings at the pump and well head; see the [stainless well riser coupling](/p/stainless-well-riser-hose-coupling).

faqs.q: Does the riser winding trailer carry a certificate?
faqs.a: No standard or certificate is listed for the winding trailer. It is built to order, so state any road-use or site requirements with the enquiry and we confirm them with the quotation.

faqs.q: How is a submersible pump serviced with the riser winding trailer?
faqs.a: The powered reel lowers the pump and riser hose and recovers them for service, with the pump cable wound alongside. See the [well riser hose installation guide](/blog/well-riser-hose-installation).

faqs.q: Where is the well riser hose winding trailer used?
faqs.a: It is used for installing and servicing submersible pumps in deep boreholes and by well-field maintenance crews moving between wells.

faqs.q: 2-inch riser winding trailer or the 8-inch system?
faqs.a: The 2" trailer carries 300 m of riser hose with cable and has its own generator, while the [8-inch winding system](/p/riser-hose-winding-system-8-inch) holds 150 m of 8" hose. Choose by riser bore.

faqs.q: What do I send to quote the 2-inch riser winding trailer?
faqs.a: Send the hose bore and length to be handled, how the unit will be moved (towed, tractor-mounted, truck or by hand) and the power available on site.

faqs.q: Do you supply the riser winding trailer from Dubai?
faqs.a: It is built to order, so lead time is confirmed with the quotation. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide with the best lead times; send details through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Can the 2-inch riser trailer handle larger riser hose?
faqs.a: It is specified for 2" riser hose with cable. For larger riser hose see the 8" system above, and tell us your bore and borehole depth.
